text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack web developer with 7 years of experience building modern, high-performing websites and web apps. I’d love to help with your web development and design needs, especially where strong UX/UI, clean front-end implementation, and reliable delivery all matter.

I’ve worked on projects that required both thoughtful design execution and solid development fundamentals. For example, on the Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS that the marketing team could edit themselves. Using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Sanity, and Vercel, I focused on creating a faster, cleaner experience that also supported the business side of the site. The result was a major improvement in performance, with largest contentful paint reduced from 4.1s to 1.3s, and organic traffic up 38% in 3 months.

That kind of work reflects how I approach projects: balancing design quality, usability, and implementation details so the final product looks good and performs well. I’m comfortable working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Stripe, and I pay close attention to responsive layout, maintainable code, and smooth user experience.

I also understand the importance of collaboration. I’m used to working with teams, communicating clearly, and keeping projects moving forward while meeting deadlines. Whether the work involves turning design concepts into polished pages or improving an existing site, I aim to deliver reliable results that fit the project goals and timeline.

If you’re looking for someone who can combine strong front-end development with practical design thinking and a collaborative approach, I’d be glad to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
